---
title: "Validate suSiE RSS on CBX8 Phase 1 Outputs"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r setup}
required_packages <- c("arrow", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "Matrix", "readr", "susieR", "tibble")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required R packages: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    ". Install them before running this notebook."
  )
}

library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(Matrix)
library(readr)
library(susieR)
library(tibble)

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidates <- c(normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE), dirname(normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)))
  # Example fallback path -- set to your environment.
  hardcoded <- "/path/to/eQTL_annotations_for_susine"
  candidates <- c(candidates, dirname(candidates), hardcoded)
  candidates <- unique(normalizePath(candidates, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))

  for (candidate in candidates) {
    if (
      dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "utils")) &&
      dir.exists(file.path(candidate, "vignettes")) &&
      file.exists(file.path(candidate, "README.md"))
    ) {
      return(candidate)
    }
  }

  stop("Could not locate eQTL_annotations_for_susine project root")
}

PROJECT_ROOT <- find_project_root()
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
Z_SCORE_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "z_score")
LD_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "ld")
ANNOTATION_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "annotation", "alphagenome")

GENE_NAME <- "CBX8"
MAX_VARIANTS <- NULL
SUSIE_L <- 10

MASTER_PATH <- file.path(LD_DIR, sprintf("%s_phase1_master_variants.csv", GENE_NAME))
ORDER_PATH <- file.path(LD_DIR, sprintf("%s_LD_variant_order.tsv", GENE_NAME))
LD_LONG_PATH <- file.path(LD_DIR, sprintf("%s_phase1_LD_R_long.parquet", GENE_NAME))
ANNOTATION_PATH <- file.path(ANNOTATION_DIR, sprintf("%s_alphagenome_variant_scores.csv", GENE_NAME))

cat("Project root:", PROJECT_ROOT, "\n")
cat("Master path:", MASTER_PATH, "\n")
cat("LD order path:", ORDER_PATH, "\n")
cat("LD parquet path:", LD_LONG_PATH, "\n")
cat("Annotation path:", ANNOTATION_PATH, "\n")
```

## Load and align z, a, and LD order

```{r load-inputs}
master_df <- readr::read_csv(MASTER_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)
order_df <- readr::read_tsv(ORDER_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)
annotation_df <- readr::read_csv(ANNOTATION_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(nrow(master_df) == nrow(order_df))

aligned_df <- order_df %>%
  left_join(
    master_df %>%
      transmute(
        variant_id,
        z = z_score,
        sample_size,
        ld_matrix_index
      ),
    by = c("id" = "variant_id")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    annotation_df %>%
      transmute(
        variant_id = source_variant_id,
        a = alphagenome_raw_mean,
        alphagenome_track_count
      ),
    by = c("id" = "variant_id")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    a_missing = is.na(a),
    a = if_else(is.na(a), 0, a)
  ) %>%
  arrange(index)

stopifnot(all(aligned_df$index == seq_len(nrow(aligned_df)) - 1L))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(aligned_df$z)))

if (!is.null(MAX_VARIANTS)) {
  keep_n <- min(MAX_VARIANTS, nrow(aligned_df))
  aligned_df <- aligned_df %>% slice_head(n = keep_n)
}

z <- aligned_df$z
a <- aligned_df$a
n_vec <- aligned_df$sample_size
n_rss <- round(mean(n_vec))

cat("Variants loaded:", nrow(aligned_df), "\n")
cat("Annotation-missing variants filled with 0:", sum(aligned_df$a_missing), "\n")
cat("Mean sample size used for susie_rss n:", n_rss, "\n")
```

## Reconstruct the dense LD matrix

```{r build-r}
ld_long_df <- arrow::read_parquet(LD_LONG_PATH) %>%
  as_tibble()

if (!is.null(MAX_VARIANTS)) {
  ld_long_df <- ld_long_df %>%
    filter(snp_index_1 < nrow(aligned_df), snp_index_2 < nrow(aligned_df))
}

p <- nrow(aligned_df)
R_sparse <- sparseMatrix(
  i = c(ld_long_df$snp_index_1 + 1L, ld_long_df$snp_index_2 + 1L, seq_len(p)),
  j = c(ld_long_df$snp_index_2 + 1L, ld_long_df$snp_index_1 + 1L, seq_len(p)),
  x = c(ld_long_df$r, ld_long_df$r, rep(1, p)),
  dims = c(p, p)
)
R <- as.matrix(R_sparse)

rm(ld_long_df, R_sparse)
gc()

cat("LD matrix dimension:", paste(dim(R), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("Max asymmetry:", max(abs(R - t(R))), "\n")
cat("Diagonal range:", paste(range(diag(R)), collapse = " to "), "\n")
```

## Basic validation checks

```{r validation}
stopifnot(length(z) == nrow(R), length(a) == nrow(R))
stopifnot(max(abs(R - t(R))) < 1e-8)
stopifnot(all(abs(diag(R) - 1) < 1e-8))

validation_summary <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "p_variants",
    "z_mean",
    "z_sd",
    "annotation_mean",
    "annotation_sd",
    "annotation_zero_count",
    "n_rss"
  ),
  value = c(
    length(z),
    mean(z),
    sd(z),
    mean(a),
    sd(a),
    sum(a == 0),
    n_rss
  )
)

validation_summary
```

## Run susie_rss

Note: `susie_rss` uses `z` and `R`. The annotation vector `a` is loaded and aligned here for validation, but it is not consumed by `susie_rss`.

```{r run-susie}
susie_fit <- susieR::susie_rss(
  z = z,
  R = R,
  n = n_rss,
  L = SUSIE_L,
  estimate_residual_variance = FALSE,
  check_prior = FALSE
)

susie_summary <- tibble(
  pip_gt_0_1 = sum(susie_fit$pip > 0.1),
  pip_gt_0_5 = sum(susie_fit$pip > 0.5),
  cs_count = length(susie_fit$sets$cs),
  elbo_last = tail(susie_fit$elbo, 1)
)

susie_summary
```

## Inspect top variants

```{r inspect-top}
top_df <- aligned_df %>%
  mutate(pip = susie_fit$pip) %>%
  arrange(desc(pip)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

top_df %>%
  select(index, id, chrom, pos, ref, alt, z, a, alphagenome_track_count, pip)
```

## Quick plots

```{r quick-plots, fig.height=4, fig.width=7}
ggplot(aligned_df %>% mutate(pip = susie_fit$pip), aes(x = z, y = pip, color = a)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("%s: z vs PIP with AlphaGenome annotation", GENE_NAME),
    x = "z-score",
    y = "PIP",
    color = "a"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r handoff}
str(list(
  z = z,
  a = a,
  R_dim = dim(R),
  n_rss = n_rss
))
```
